html_source: Colorized and sound-added Pathé film of Dublin shot by J. Gordon Lewis in 1915, showing, among other scenes, a brewery barge on the Liffey, College Green and the Bank of Ireland, Lower O'Connell Street, and the O'Connell bridge—all depicted in Lestrygonians. Source: www.youtube.com.

Colorized and sound-added Pathé film of Dublin shot by J. Gordon
  Lewis in 1915, showing, among other scenes, a brewery barge on
  the Liffey, College Green and the Bank of Ireland, Lower
  O'Connell Street, and the O'Connell bridge––all depicted in
  Lestrygonians. Source: www.youtube.com.
